newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf, Total weaken on Iraq fears.
newsitem.headline: Elf, Total weaken on Iraq fears.

text.p: Shares in oil majors Elf Aquitaine and Total SA weakened on Thursday in the light of current tension over Iraq, traders said.
They said Elf was down despite higher than expected first half profits, while Total also suffered from yesterday's U.S. announcement of cruise missiles strikes against Iraq, they said.
Elf was down three francs at 379.5, or 0.78 percent, at 1139 GMT, while Total was also down three francs at 382, or 0.78 percent. The CAC-40 index was up 0.53 percent.
"Elf Aquitaine, as well as Total, is suffering from the uncertainties in the Iraq situation and the consequences this might have on the price of Brent crude," said one operator.
However, operators noted with satisfaction that Elf's 24 percent increase in first-half profit to 3.56 billion francs was higher than the company's 20 percent forecast in June.
